title: O3 gets image input; search gets its route
summary:
O3 gained image input, searchgpt got its routing straightened out, and the model list gained tier metadata.

Added `openai-reasoning` for O3 with text and image input, plus `searchgpt` for GPT-4o mini search preview. Follow-up changes corrected the `searchgpt` routing so the listed model maps to the intended search model.

Text model definitions now include tier and community metadata. GPT-4.1 and Qwen 2.5 Coder provider-model aliases were also added, and `openai-fast` now uses a GPT-4.1-nano alias.

Added @Th3-C0der’s DynaSpark API to Hack & Build. Its documented Python package uses Pollinations for text, images, and audio in web and desktop projects.

daily.text: Send text and image inputs to `openai-reasoning`, the O3 model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-reasoning).

daily.text: Use `searchgpt` for GPT-4o mini search preview through the text API. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=searchgpt).
